roles.Full Access: All platform surfaces, full write access including User Management
roles.AEP Manager: AEP campaign creation and management only; AEP-scoped dashboard
roles.Training & Simulations Manager: Training and simulated attack campaigns; training-scoped dashboard
roles.Dashboard Viewer: Read-only access to dashboards; no write access on any surface
